female.sp: Bandit G-M1F from Turn A Gundam. Use the central orange-and-cream Bandit in the attached original animation reference as the sole equipment design source; do not copy the other two units, their poses, their background, or the cel-shaded style. Translate the orange torso armor, pale cream limb armor, dark frame, unusual curved shoulder units and large movable rear thrusters into a recognizably human armored silhouette. Preserve its squeeze-weapon equipment as stowed external mechanisms and the canonical beam saber. Retain source identity rather than generic Gundam plates. A mysterious, agile human silhouette framed by alien-looking external mechanical armor. No biological extra limbs and no fantasy wings. Normal human anatomy: one human head with clearly visible face, two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand; no robot face or extra limbs. Keep recognizable shoulder armor. Subtle adult sensuality. No camera pullback to create margins; maintain close full-body framing with feet and major equipment visible.
